comment: Read by scripts/third-party-notices.mjs. 'copyright': crates for which no licence file with a real copyright notice exists in the crate or its repository. Their text is the licence template of cargo-about with the placeholder replaced by 'holder'. basis 'authors': holder is the authors field of the crate (checked against cargo metadata at the exact version). basis 'repository': holder named from the upstream repository, see 'source'. An entry is used only for the exact name and version, and an entry that is no longer needed is an error. 'vendored': front-end files that are copied into the repository and served to the browser; the licence text is committed in legal/, and the hashes pin the licence and the files it applies to, so a new version of a file fails the check until the licence is looked at again. 'fontLicenseFile': the licence of the Inter font that is served from static/fonts/.
intro: The Rust crates are those that the server binary is built from (the static Linux builds
for x86_64 and aarch64 that the release archives and the Docker image contain). A crate that only
runs while the program is built (a build script) is not listed. A crate that is only used at
build time through a procedural macro may be listed.
The web interface also serves a few third-party files to the browser: htmx and the Inter font.
They are listed after the Rust crates.

copyright.name: asn1-rs-impl
copyright.source: https://github.com/rusticata/asn1-rs at the commit the crate was published from (a20e5f7319c896737ad0f2557037817b91ad854f): LICENSE-MIT in the root of the repository begins with "Copyright (c) 2017 Pierre Chifflier". The crate itself, a procedural macro in the folder impl/, carries no licence files.
